React contribution panels for entity-specific editing and structured nested notes, references/tags/backlinks/appearances, scene metadata, thread lifecycle, relationship overlay, chronology, location links, reader knowledge, world state, Zukan review, and series binding. Zukan suggestions can be created from snapshot-validated manuscript or dialogue-sketch evidence as pending-only reviewable proposals; freshness hashes, stable IDs, source revisions, and stale-row updates remain bound to the source snapshot. Approval updates nested entity notes and workflow status atomically; rejection updates only workflow status.
